educational_goal: Perform the Class 12 microscale chemistry experiment 'Characterise carbohydrates, fats, and proteins in food' and record its manual-defined observations and result.
materials: well plate, micro test tubes, glucose, starch, oil, milk, egg, Molisch reagent, Benedict solution, iodine
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.
